C9000063.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 063 (The generalized Mukai conjecture.; papers: The generalized Mukai conjecture; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

CMAIN.statement: For every smooth connected complex Fano X of dimension n>0, Picard number rho and pseudoindex iota, rho(iota-1)<=n, with equality exactly for (P^(iota-1))^rho.

CDESC.statement: With exactly the hypotheses of prop:descendant-bound, the numerical-degree point descendant is at least (a*d)^(-(d-1)).

CGENERAL.statement: The same lower bound b^(-(d-1)) holds for any very ample H on any smooth complex projective X on which every irreducible rational curve has anticanonical degree at least two, where b=H.beta and beta has a nonconstant free representative.

CFREE.statement: A suitable very general evaluation point excludes every nonfree rational map; the nonempty smooth-source evaluation fiber is smooth of dimension d-2 and its virtual class restricts to its fundamental class.

CCON.statement: There is a base-change-compatible marked-component contraction on the full ambient projective stable-map stack, inducing a proper map of the evaluation fiber to the stated positive-weight projective stack.

CPSI.statement: The contraction is an isomorphism near the marking and identifies its cotangent line with the pullback of positive O(1), not O(-1).

CSTACK.statement: On the smooth-source locus the coefficient construction is an isomorphism onto its locally closed image as stacks, with identical stabilizers and generic stack degree one.

CBDRY.statement: For rational anticanonical degrees at least delta>=2, the image of a boundary stratum with u root attachments has dimension at most (d-2)-(delta-1)*u.

CCHOW.statement: Chow localization and the strict boundary-image dimension bound make the pushed-forward virtual evaluation-fiber class a nonempty effective sum of integral stack cycles.

CWEIGHT.statement: Every integral h-dimensional closed substack of a weighted projective stack with weights at most b has O(1)-degree at least b^(-(h+1)), including generic stabilizer denominators.

CDENSE.statement: Nonconstant free numerical degrees form an additive, positive-multiple-closed, Zariski-dense subset of N_1(X)_C.

CREC.statement: The manuscript's virtual descendant recurrence and string pairing hold with its numerical-degree and unstable conventions.

CSPEC.statement: The recurrence, free-degree density and point-descendant lower bound force an algebraically independent joint diagonal tuple of the quantum divisors.

CTRACE.statement: The alternating trace construction converts that tuple into a nonzero product of correspondences in independent degrees with sum(d_j-1)<=n.

CEQUALITY.statement: At equality the correspondence support supplies proper minimal families, and the corrected ordered-chain and product-characterization hypotheses hold.

CEXACT.statement: The retained exact algebra certificate replays: Smith invariants (1,2,12), coarse degree 24, generic stabilizer 2 and stack degree 48 for weights (2,4,6); the formal boundary-gap identity is 1+s+t+s*t+r. Bounded supporting tests are not a proof of virtual geometry.
